g.text: FIGURE 5: PARTICULAR INTEGRAL OPERATOR CALCULUS & VARIATION OF PARAMETERS ENGINE
Inverse Operator 1/f(D), The 5 Canonical Shortcut Rules, Failure Differentiation & Wronskian Variation of Parameters
INVERSE OPERATOR DEFINITION: y_p = [ 1 / f(D) ] X(x)
Definition: [1/f(D)] X is that function y_p which when operated upon by f(D) gives X.
CASE 1: X = e^(ax) ⟹ REPLACE D BY a
FAILURE CASE (f(a) = 0): Multiply by x and differentiate denominator!
CASE 2: X = sin(ax) OR cos(ax) ⟹ REPLACE D² BY -a²
PI = [ 1 / φ(D²) ] sin(ax) = [ 1 / φ(-a²) ] sin(ax) (if φ(-a²) ≠ 0)
⚠️ FATAL TRAP: Replace D² by -(a²), NOT (-a)² = +a²! (Never replace odd powers D directly).
If denominator becomes linear (aD + b), rationalize by multiplying numerator & denominator by (aD - b).
FAILURE CASE (φ(-a²) = 0): PI = x · [ 1 / φ'(D²) ] sin(ax) ⟹ [ 1/(D²+a²) ] sin(ax) = -(x/2a) cos(ax).
CASE 3: X = xᵐ ⟹ EXPAND [f(D)]⁻¹ IN ASCENDING POWERS OF D
Factor lowest power of D out to form [1 ± φ(D)]⁻¹, expand binomially up to order m:
2. EXPONENTIAL SHIFT & x · V OPERATOR RULES
CASE 4: EXPONENTIAL SHIFT RULE: X = e^(ax) V(x)
Exponential shifts to the front; D is replaced by (D + a):
Evaluate PI for (D² - 2D + 1) y = x e^(3x):
CASE 5: MULTIPLICATION BY x RULE: X = x V(x)
Evaluate PI for (D² + 4) y = x sin(2x):
Notice: Standard formula yields x [1/(D²+4)] sin 2x - [2D/(D²+4)²] sin 2x.
First term has failure: [1/(D²+4)] sin 2x = -(x/4) cos 2x ⟹ x(-x/4 cos 2x) = -(x²/4) cos 2x
Second term: [2D / (D²+4)²] sin 2x = -(x/8) sin 2x ⟹ Solves completely without integration!
CANONICAL MVP FORMULATION: y'' + P(x) y' + Q(x) y = X(x)
Let CF = c₁ y₁(x) + c₂ y₂(x). Replace constants c₁, c₂ by variable functions u(x), v(x):
WHY MVP IS INDISPENSABLE IN GATE
Standard operator shortcuts FAIL whenever RHS X(x) is not e^(ax), sin ax, cos ax, or xᵐ!
MVP handles functions where 1/f(D) shortcuts CANNOT be applied:
• X = tan x, sec x, csc x, cot x
⚠️ TOP GATE TRAP: LEADING COEFFICIENT MUST BE 1!
If equation is a₀ y'' + a₁ y' + a₂ y = X, you MUST divide entire equation by a₀ first!
Failure to divide by a₀ leads to wrong Particular Integral by factor 1/a₀!
4. COMPLETE STEP-BY-STEP MVP DRILL: y'' + y = sec x (CLASSIC GATE QUESTION)
y_c = c₁ cos x + c₂ sin x
u(x) = - ∫ (sin x / cos x) dx = - ∫ tan x dx
Note: No arbitrary constants added to u and v (they belong to CF!).
y_p = (ln|cos x|) cos x + x sin x
2. Full General Solution y = CF + PI:
y = c₁ cos x + c₂ sin x + cos x · ln|cos x| + x sin x
y' = -c₁ sin x + c₂ cos x - sin x ln|cos x| - sin x + sin x + x cos x
y'' = -c₁ cos x - c₂ sin x - cos x ln|cos x| + tan x sin x + cos x - x sin x
⟹ y'' + y = tan x sin x + cos x = (sin² x + cos² x) / cos x = 1 / cos x = sec x ✓
DIFFERENTIAL EQUATIONS MATHEMATICAL BLUEPRINT // SCALE: 1.0 NATIVE // GATE / ESE / ISRO EXCELLENCE SUITE
